intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Chesapeake for 2026, and here is what he found: 12 family events, with 4 new listings added to the 7 already live and the Chesapeake Rotary Christmas Parade moved over from Virginia Beach. The new listings run from November 26 (Pugh Family Christmas Light Show) through December 25, with Breakfast With Santa at Fire Station 5 (December 5), the Grinch and Polar Express Programs at Chesapeake Public Library (December 5, 18 and 19) and the VSO Holiday Brass Concert (December 10) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Chesapeake

  • 12 Christmas events for kids in Chesapeake
  • Free events, including the VSO Holiday Brass Concert and the Chesapeake Rotary Christmas Parade
  • Meet Santa: Breakfast With Santa at Fire Station 5 on December 5
  • Parades and tree lightings: the Chesapeake Rotary Christmas Parade
  • Light displays: Pugh Family Christmas Light Show through December 25
  • Season: November 26 to December 25, 2026 for the new listings

Planning a bigger day out? Chesapeake families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Virginia Beach, which covers the Bayport Credit Union Holiday Trail of Lights at the Virginia Aquarium, Planes, Trains and Santa at the Military Aviation Museum and the Snow Globe Spectacular at Town Center.
